verses.original: וַיַּבְדֵּ֣ל דָּוִיד֩ וְשָׂרֵ֨י הַצָּבָ֜א לַעֲבֹדָ֗ה לִבְנֵ֤י אָסָף֙ וְהֵימָ֣ן וִֽידוּת֔וּן הַנְּבִּיאִים בְּכִנֹּר֥וֹת בִּנְבָלִ֖ים וּבִמְצִלְתָּ֑יִם וַֽיְהִי֙ מִסְפָּרָ֔ם אַנְשֵׁ֥י מְלָאכָ֖ה לַעֲבֹדָתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḇ·dêl dā·wîḏ wə·śā·rê haṣ·ṣā·ḇā la·‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh liḇ·nê ’ā·sāp̄ wə·hê·mān wî·ḏū·ṯūn han·nə·bī·ʾīm bə·ḵin·nō·rō·wṯ bin·ḇā·lîm ū·ḇim·ṣil·tā·yim way·hî mis·pā·rām ’an·šê mə·lā·ḵāh la·‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯām
verses.literal: Additionally, David and the commanders of the army . . . set apart some of the sons of Asaph Heman and Jeduthun to prophesy with the accompaniment of lyres harps and cymbals The following is the list of the men who performed this service
verses.literalPt: E DAVI, juntamente com os capitães do exército, separou para o ministério os filhos de Asafe, e de Hemã, e de Jedutum, para profetizarem com harpas, com címbalos, e com saltérios; e este foi o número dos homens aptos para a obra do seu ministério:

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י אָסָ֗ף זַכּ֧וּר וְיוֹסֵ֛ף וּנְתַנְיָ֥ה וַאֲשַׂרְאֵ֖לָה בְּנֵ֣י אָסָ֑ף עַ֚ל יַד־ אָסָ֔ף הַנִּבָּ֖א עַל־ יְדֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: liḇ·nê ’ā·sāp̄ zak·kūr wə·yō·w·sêp̄ ū·nə·ṯan·yāh wa·’ă·śar·’ê·lāh bə·nê ’ā·sāp̄ ‘al yaḏ- ’ā·sāp̄ han·nib·bā ‘al- yə·ḏê ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: From the sons of Asaph Zaccur Joseph Nethaniah and Asarelah These sons of Asaph were under the direction of Asaph who prophesied under the direction of the king
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Asafe: Zacur, José, Netanias, e Asarela, filhos de Asafe; a cargo de Asafe, que profetizava debaixo das ordens do rei Davi.

verses.original: לִידוּת֑וּן בְּנֵ֣י יְדוּת֡וּן גְּדַלְיָ֡הוּ וּצְרִ֡י וִֽ֠ישַׁעְיָהוּ חֲשַׁבְיָ֨הוּ וּמַתִּתְיָ֜הוּ שִׁשָּׁ֗ה עַל֩ יְדֵ֨י אֲבִיהֶ֤ם יְדוּתוּן֙ בַּכִּנּ֔וֹר הַנִּבָּ֕א עַל־ הֹד֥וֹת וְהַלֵּ֖ל לַיהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: lî·ḏū·ṯūn bə·nê yə·ḏū·ṯūn gə·ḏal·yā·hū ū·ṣə·rî wî·ša‘·yā·hū ḥă·šaḇ·yā·hū ū·mat·tiṯ·yā·hū šiš·šāh ‘al yə·ḏê ’ă·ḇî·hem yə·ḏū·ṯūn bak·kin·nō·wr han·nib·bā ‘al- hō·ḏō·wṯ wə·hal·lêl Yah·weh
verses.literal: From the sons of Jeduthun Gedaliah Zeri Jeshaiah , Shimei Hashabiah and Mattithiah six in all under the direction of their father Jeduthun who prophesied with the harp giving thanks and praise to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Quanto a Jedutum, os filhos: Gedalias, Zeri, Jesaías, Hasabias, e Matitias, seis, a cargo de seu pai, Jedutum, o qual profetizava com a harpa, louvando e dando graças ao SENHOR.

verses.original: לְהֵימָ֑ן בְּנֵ֣י הֵימָ֡ן בֻּקִּיָּ֡הוּ מַתַּנְיָ֡הוּ עֻ֠זִּיאֵל שְׁבוּאֵ֨ל וִֽירִימ֜וֹת חֲנַנְיָ֣ה חֲנָ֗נִי אֱלִיאָ֤תָה גִדַּ֙לְתִּי֙ וְרֹמַ֣מְתִּי עֶ֔זֶר יָשְׁבְּקָ֣שָׁה מַלּ֔וֹתִי הוֹתִ֖יר מַחֲזִיאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: lə·hê·mān bə·nê hê·mān buq·qî·yā·hū mat·tan·yā·hū ‘uz·zî·’êl šə·ḇū·’êl wî·rî·mō·wṯ ḥă·nan·yāh ḥă·nā·nî ’ĕ·lî·’ā·ṯāh ḡid·dal·tî wə·rō·mam·tî ‘e·zer yā·šə·bə·qā·šāh mal·lō·w·ṯî hō·w·ṯîr ma·ḥă·zî·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: From the sons of Heman Bukkiah Mattaniah Uzziel Shebuel Jerimoth Hananiah Hanani Eliathah Giddalti Romamti-ezer Joshbekashah Mallothi Hothir and Mahazioth
verses.literalPt: Quanto a Hemã, os filhos: Buquias, Matanias, Uziel, Sebuel, Jerimote, Hananias, Hanani, Eliata, Gidalti, Romanti-Ezer, Josbecasa, Maloti, Hotir, e Maaziote.

verses.original: כָּל־ אֵ֨לֶּה בָנִ֜ים לְהֵימָ֗ן חֹזֵ֥ה הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ בְּדִבְרֵ֥י הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים לְהָרִ֣ים קָ֑רֶן וַיִּתֵּ֨ן הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים לְהֵימָ֗ן בָּנִ֛ים אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר וּבָנ֥וֹת שָׁלֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’êl·leh ḇā·nîm lə·hê·mān ḥō·zêh ham·me·leḵ bə·ḏiḇ·rê hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·hā·rîm qā·ren way·yit·tên hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·hê·mān bā·nîm ’ar·bā·‘āh ‘ā·śār ū·ḇā·nō·wṯ šā·lō·wōš
verses.literal: All these sons of Heman the king’s seer were given him through the promises of God to exalt him for God had given Heman fourteen . . . sons and three daughters
verses.literalPt: Todos estes foram filhos de Hemã, o vidente do rei nas palavras de Deus, para exaltar o seu poder; porque Deus dera a Hemã catorze filhos e três filhas.

verses.original: כָּל־ אֵ֣לֶּה עַל־ יְדֵי֩ אֲבִיהֶ֨ם בַּשִּׁ֜יר בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֗ה בִּמְצִלְתַּ֙יִם֙ נְבָלִ֣ים וְכִנֹּר֔וֹת לַעֲבֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים עַ֚ל יְדֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְס אָסָ֥ף וִידוּת֖וּן וְהֵימָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’êl·leh ‘al- yə·ḏê ’ă·ḇî·hem baš·šîr bêṯ Yah·weh bim·ṣil·ta·yim nə·ḇā·lîm wə·ḵin·nō·rō·wṯ la·‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ bêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘al yə·ḏê ham·mɛ·lɛḵs ’ā·sāp̄ wî·ḏū·ṯūn wə·hê·mān
verses.literal: All these were under the direction of their fathers for the music of the house of the LORD with cymbals harps and lyres for the service of the house of God Asaph Jeduthun and Heman were under the direction of the king
verses.literalPt: Todos estes estavam sob a direção de seu pai, para a música da casa do SENHOR, com saltérios, címbalos e harpas, para o ministério da casa de Deus; e Asafe, Jedutum, e Hemã, estavam sob as ordens do rei.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י מִסְפָּרָם֙ עִם־ אֲחֵיהֶ֔ם מְלֻמְּדֵי־ שִׁ֖יר לַיהוָ֑ה כָּל־ הַ֨מֵּבִ֔ין מָאתַ֖יִם שְׁמוֹנִ֥ים וּשְׁמוֹנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî mis·pā·rām ‘im- ’ă·ḥê·hem mə·lum·mə·ḏê- šîr Yah·weh kāl- ham·mê·ḇîn mā·ṯa·yim šə·mō·w·nîm ū·šə·mō·w·nāh
verses.literal: Together with their relatives who were all trained and skillful in the songs of the LORD they numbered 288 . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: E era o número deles, juntamente com seus irmãos instruídos no canto ao SENHOR, todos eles mestres, duzentos e oitenta e oito.

verses.original: וַיַּפִּ֜ילוּ גּוֹרָל֣וֹת מִשְׁמֶ֗רֶת לְעֻמַּת֙ כַּקָּטֹ֣ן כַּגָּד֔וֹל מֵבִ֖ין עִם־ תַּלְמִֽיד׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yap·pî·lū gō·w·rā·lō·wṯ miš·me·reṯ lə·‘um·maṯ kaq·qā·ṭōn kag·gā·ḏō·wl mê·ḇîn ‘im- tal·mîḏ
verses.literal: They cast lots for their duties . . . young and old alike teacher as well as pupil
verses.literalPt: E deitaram sortes acerca da guarda igualmente, assim o pequeno como o grande, o mestre juntamente com o discípulo.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֞א הַגּוֹרָ֧ל הָרִאשׁ֛וֹן לְאָסָ֖ף לְיוֹסֵ֑ף גְּדַלְיָ֙הוּ֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י הֽוּא־ וְאֶחָ֥יו וּבָנָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê hag·gō·w·rāl hā·ri·šō·wn lə·’ā·sāp̄ lə·yō·w·sêp̄ gə·ḏal·yā·hū haš·šê·nî hū- wə·’e·ḥāw ū·ḇā·nāw šə·nêm ‘ā·śār
verses.literal: The first lot which was for Asaph fell to Joseph, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all the second to Gedaliah his sons and his brothers 12 in all . . .
verses.literalPt: Saiu, pois, a primeira sorte a Asafe, a saber a José; a segunda a Gedalias; e ele, e seus irmãos, e seus filhos, ao todo eram doze.

verses.original: הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֣י זַכּ֔וּר בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.literal: the third to Zaccur his sons and his brothers 12 in all . . .
verses.literalPt: A terceira a Zacur, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.

verses.original: הָרְבִיעִי֙ לַיִּצְרִ֔י בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.literal: the fourth to Izri his sons and his brothers 12 in all . . .
verses.literalPt: A quarta a Izri, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.

verses.original: הַחֲמִישִׁ֣י נְתַנְיָ֔הוּ בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.literal: the fifth to Nethaniah his sons and his brothers 12 in all . . .
verses.literalPt: A quinta a Netanias, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.

verses.original: הַשִּׁשִּׁ֣י בֻקִּיָּ֔הוּ בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.literal: the sixth to Bukkiah his sons and his brothers 12 in all . . .
verses.literalPt: A sexta a Buquias, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.

verses.original: הַשְּׁבִעִ֣י יְשַׂרְאֵ֔לָה בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.literal: the seventh to Jesarelah his sons and his brothers 12 in all . . .
verses.literalPt: A sétima a Jesarela, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.

verses.original: הַשְּׁמִינִ֣י יְשַֽׁעְיָ֔הוּ בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.literal: the eighth to Jeshaiah his sons and his brothers 12 in all . . .
verses.literalPt: A oitava a Jesaías, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.

verses.original: הַתְּשִׁיעִ֣י מַתַּנְיָ֔הוּ בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.literal: the ninth to Mattaniah his sons and his brothers 12 in all . . .
verses.literalPt: A nona a Matanias, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.

verses.original: הָעֲשִׂירִ֣י שִׁמְעִ֔י בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.literal: the tenth to Shimei his sons and his brothers 12 in all . . .
verses.literalPt: A décima a Simei, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.

verses.original: עַשְׁתֵּֽי־ עָשָׂ֣ר עֲזַרְאֵ֔ל בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.literal: the eleventh . . . to Azarel his sons and his brothers 12 in all . . .
verses.literalPt: A undécima a Azareel, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.

verses.original: הַשְּׁנֵ֤ים עָשָׂר֙ לַחֲשַׁבְיָ֔ה בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.literal: the twelfth . . . to Hashabiah his sons and his brothers 12 in all . . .
verses.literalPt: A duodécima a Hasabias, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.

verses.original: לִשְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ שֽׁוּבָאֵ֔ל בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.literal: the thirteenth . . . to Shubael his sons and his brothers 12 in all . . .
verses.literalPt: A décima terceira a Subael, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.

verses.original: לְאַרְבָּעָ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ מַתִּתְיָ֔הוּ בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.literal: the fourteenth . . . to Mattithiah his sons and his brothers 12 in all . . .
verses.literalPt: A décima quarta a Matitias, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.

verses.original: לַחֲמִשָּׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ לִֽירֵמ֔וֹת בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.literal: the fifteenth . . . to Jeremoth his sons and his brothers 12 in all . . .
verses.literalPt: A décima quinta a Jeremote, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.

verses.original: לְשִׁשָּׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ לַחֲנַנְיָ֔הוּ בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.literal: the sixteenth . . . to Hananiah his sons and his brothers 12 in all . . .
verses.literalPt: A décima sexta a Hananias, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.

verses.original: לְשִׁבְעָ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ לְיָשְׁבְּקָ֔שָׁה בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.literal: the seventeenth . . . to Joshbekashah his sons and his brothers 12 in all . . .
verses.literalPt: A décima sétima a Josbecasa, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.

verses.original: לִשְׁמוֹנָ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ לַחֲנָ֔נִי בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.literal: the eighteenth . . . to Hanani his sons and his brothers 12 in all . . .
verses.literalPt: A décima oitava a Hanani, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.

verses.original: לְתִשְׁעָ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ לְמַלּ֔וֹתִי בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.literal: the nineteenth . . . to Mallothi his sons and his brothers 12 in all . . .
verses.literalPt: A décima nona a Maloti, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.

verses.original: לְעֶשְׂרִים֙ לֶֽאֱלִיָּ֔תָה בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.literal: the twentieth to Eliathah his sons and his brothers 12 in all . . .
verses.literalPt: A vigésima a Eliata, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.

verses.original: לְאֶחָ֤ד וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ לְהוֹתִ֔יר בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.transliteration: lə·’e·ḥāḏ wə·‘eś·rîm lə·hō·w·ṯîr bā·nāw wə·’e·ḥāw šə·nêm ‘ā·śār
verses.literal: the twenty-first . . . to Hothir his sons and his brothers 12 in all . . .
verses.literalPt: A vigésima primeira a Hotir, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.

verses.original: לִשְׁנַ֤יִם וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ לְגִדַּ֔לְתִּי בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.transliteration: liš·na·yim wə·‘eś·rîm lə·ḡid·dal·tî bā·nāw wə·’e·ḥāw šə·nêm ‘ā·śār
verses.literal: the twenty-second . . . to Giddalti his sons and his brothers 12 in all . . .
verses.literalPt: A vigésima segunda a Gidalti, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.

verses.original: לִשְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ לְמַ֣חֲזִיא֔וֹת בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.transliteration: liš·lō·šāh wə·‘eś·rîm lə·ma·ḥă·zî·’ō·wṯ bā·nāw wə·’e·ḥāw šə·nêm ‘ā·śār
verses.literal: the twenty-third . . . to Mahazioth his sons and his brothers 12 in all . . .
verses.literalPt: A vigésima terceira a Maaziote, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.

verses.original: לְאַרְבָּעָ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ לְרוֹמַ֣מְתִּי עָ֔זֶר בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃פ
verses.transliteration: lə·’ar·bā·‘āh wə·‘eś·rîm lə·rō·w·mam·tî ‘ā·zer bā·nāw wə·’e·ḥāw šə·nêm ‘ā·śār
verses.literal: and the twenty-fourth . . . to Romamti-ezer his sons and his brothers 12 in all . . .
verses.literalPt: A vigésima quarta a Romanti-Ezer, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.
